sec.title: OpenAI Announced $1B in Defensive Tools for Water Utilities
sec.brief: S. S. 5 Million Records OpenAI announced Daybreak for Frontline Defenders on September 3, 2026, committing $1 billion in subsidized access to its Daybreak cyber models, training, and technical support to help organizations that protect essential services in the United States and internationally. “A $1 billion global commitment to expand subsidized access to Daybreak cyber models and products, training, technical support, and partnerships in the United States and internationally. com. The $1 billion is product credits and subsidized access, not a cash grant, targeted to be used over the next six months.
